HOW TO CHOOSE

A few useful questions.

Does it feel like Lain?Consider the tone before the color. Warm and thoughtful, precise and technical, or playful and inviting?

Does it explain the product?Each page has a working sample search and view switcher. These are synthetic demonstrations, not account access.

Does it work on your screen?Try the mobile width and the keyboard. Every direction supports reduced motion and offers the same release caveats.

Your shortlist stays in this browser. Nothing here changes the live website, application or account.
